text: marie: FYI nightly build failed during linkcheck for the localized site. CI shows: Fragment not found /fr/quickstart/#docker-screenshot alex: I can repro locally. The French build generates the image id as `docker-screenshot-1` while the English canonical link is `#docker-screenshot`. Seems like mkdocs' slugify/dedupe behavior when filenames collide across locales. sam: quick diagnosis: duplicate image filenames in /en/ and /fr/ trigger the `-1` suffix. Linkcheck hits canonical anchor and fails. priya: short-term: I'll open a tiny patch to relax the linkcheck to accept `(-\\d+)?` suffixes for fragments so CI is unblocked. Longer-term we should make id generation deterministic across locales or emit mapping redirects. marie: sounds good. Also please add a one-line contributor note recommending explicit anchors for important screenshots (example: `### Screenshot `). That prevents surprises. alex: I'll add the blurb in contributing.md in the same PR as the linkcheck tweak to reduce churn. docs-ci-bot: nightly/docs-linkcheck failed (https://ci.redwood.ai/build/8890) :x: | job: docs-linkcheck | 9m sam: created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/420 \"lint: detect duplicate autogenerated anchors across locales\" and a small grep script prototype to warn pre-PR. marie: plan: land the linkcheck relaxation to unblock CI, follow up with lint and RFC for deterministic ids. Priya/Alex, tag me on the PRs and I'll coordinate merge window so we don't disrupt release docs. :thumbsup:
